text: [excited] तीसरा man deep है, लेकिन Fine leg अंदर है — [warmly] uppercut खुला है।
english: Third man is deep, but Fine leg is inside the circle — the uppercut is on.
The option for power is open!

text: [shouts] Golly ने down the ground मारा — [shouts, ecstatic] क्या sensational hit है!
english: Golly has hit it down the ground — what a sensational hit!

text: [excited] 68 off 49 में Kohli अब turn on कर रहे हैं — [shouts] क्या tempo है!
english: Kohli is turning it on at 68 off 49 — what tempo!

text: [shouts] क्या shot है — Kohli का class!
